## TMP Community V2 staging

Import on the same n8n instance. Existing Google Sheets and Gmail credential references are preserved.

Webhook path: `tech-meets-problems-community-v2-staging`

This workflow is intentionally inactive after import. It writes new Community joins to the existing `TMP_Community_Future_Events` tab and uses the hidden `TMP_Community_V2_System` tab for idempotency and profile update tokens. Existing rows are not deleted.

Before production: restrict Allowed Origins, replace the staging webhook path, test end to end, and decide whether to move update tokens out of Sheets into an n8n Data Table or another restricted store.
